AON_WDT Exported Functions

group AON_WDT_Exported_Functions

Functions

bool AON_WDT_Start(AON_WDT_TypeDef *AON_WDTx, uint32_t TimeMs, WDTMode_TypeDef Mode)

Start AON WDT.

参数:

  • AON_WDTx -- [in] Select the AON_WDT peripheral. Refer to AON_WDT Declaration.

  • TimeMs -- [in] AON WDT Timeout Time. Unit: ms.

  • Mode -- [in] Refer to WDTMode_TypeDef. If the Reset AON WDT operation is not performed within the Timeout period, the configured mode operation will be executed.

返回:

true or false.

  • true: AON WDT mode set successfully, enabling the function..

  • false: If set to interrupt mode, it will return false.
